description: Signature TrainScope is configured through a small, explicit surface: `trainscope.alarms`, `trainscope.rollback`, `trainscope.history`. The demo below validates a sample configuration against the required keys, because most Signature TrainScope failures are configuration mistakes, and a validator catches them before they cost time.

    'trainscope.alarms': True,
    'trainscope.rollback': 'one-click',

}
